fields.office: NWS Storm Prediction Center Norman OK
fields.summary: Thunderstorms are expected to intensify over the next hour. Damaging winds and a tornado or two are possible and a tornado watch will likely be issued.
discussion: Cumulus is deepening along a surface boundary draped across southwest Ohio. MLCAPE is near 1800 J/kg with 40 kt of effective shear, supporting organized storms as the cap erodes.
Low-level shear is increasing ahead of the boundary, and a storm that interacts with it could produce a tornado.
